author: atlas22
quote: GTA 6 is honestly a huge disappointment. I don't even know if I can call this GTA anymore. You can't even commit crimes freely, and apparently you can't even mess with people at LGBTQ+ parades. Like seriously, what the **** happened to this game?Instead of the usual GTA experience, we're getting some lame love story. Jason is honestly disappointing too. Compare him to Niko Bellic, Michael or Trevor. Niko was a tough, experienced man with a dark past and a strong personality. Michael was a confident, manipulative criminal who had his own problems but never felt like a pushover. And Trevor? He was completely insane, unpredictable and didn't give a **** about **** look at Jason. He doesn't have that same presence or personality. He comes across as a weak guy who's constantly overshadowed by Lucia. Instead of feeling like an independent criminal with his own identity, he looks like someone who's just following his girlfriend around. I don't want another boring simp as a GTA protagonist.Another huge problem is that the game barely seems to make fun of anything happening in today's world. GTA has always been known for making fun of politics, celebrities, social media, corporations and pretty much everything about modern society. Where is that dark, ruthless satire?I wanted a crime game where I could cause chaos, do stupid ****, explore the world and enjoy Rockstar's dark humor. Not a lame romantic drama.Honestly, Niko, Michael and Trevor had more personality in their little finger than Jason seems to have. This doesn't feel like the GTA I grew up with. What a disappointment.
